set.ref.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young woman in <Picture 1>, <Picture 2> and <Picture 3>: a short dark chin-length bob, a long vermilion-orange tunic with full puffed sleeves, a deep indigo hooded cloak worn open over her shoulders and falling to her ankles, and dark boots. She moves slowly and carefully, with a calm, curious posture.
<Subject 2> is her double, the small figure standing beside the far wall in <Picture 3>: the same dark bob, vermilion-orange tunic and indigo cloak as <Subject 1>.
<Subject 3> is the rendering style of <Picture 1>, <Picture 2> and <Picture 3>: gouache and watercolor storybook illustration on grainy paper, flat layered shapes, teal and indigo night tones against warm cream and sepia, vermilion as the accent colour, white doves and floating golden orbs as soft glowing dabs.
<Picture 1> is the first frame of [Shot 1], showing <Subject 1> from behind with her raised hand on the bronze-stone rim of a huge round window in a stained cream plaster wall, the window opening onto a moonlit night forest with white doves.
<Picture 2> is the first frame of [Shot 2] at 00:05.000, showing <Subject 1> in profile walking right along a mossy forest path under the full moon, white doves flying low beside her and the round window glowing among the trees at upper left.
<Picture 3> is the first frame of [Shot 3] at 00:10.000, showing <Subject 1> from behind in the right foreground at the edge of a black pond, looking across it at <Subject 2> standing beside a fragment of sunlit plaster wall with a round window.

summary:
[keyframe completion + reference generation] A fifteen-second 16:9 storybook sequence in <Subject 3>, three shots opening on <Picture 1>, <Picture 2> and <Picture 3>: <Subject 1> touches a round window that looks into a night forest from a sunlit courtyard, walks through that forest following white doves, and reaches a pond where she finds <Subject 2>, her double, standing at the sunlit wall across the water.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]-[Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the same dark bob, vermilion tunic with full sleeves, indigo hooded cloak and dark boots in every shot.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - hair and clothing identical to <Subject 1>.
<Subject 3> (applies to every shot): fully_preserved - the grainy paper texture, flat gouache shapes and the teal, indigo, cream and vermilion palette.
<Picture 1> ([Shot 1] first frame): fully_preserved - the round window on the left, her raised hand on its rim and the warm stained wall.
<Picture 2> ([Shot 2] first frame): fully_preserved - her profile walking right, the doves on the left, the moon and the glowing window among the trees.
<Picture 3> ([Shot 3] first frame): fully_preserved - her back in the right foreground, the black pond with the moon's reflection, the wading doves and golden orbs, and <Subject 2> at the lit wall across the water.

detailed_description:
The target video is a hand-painted storybook animation in <Subject 3>: shapes stay flat and painterly while they move, warm cream daylight against cool teal and indigo night.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>. In a warm late-afternoon courtyard, <Subject 1> stands with her back to the camera, her raised hand resting on the bronze-stone rim of the huge round window. On this side of the wall the light is golden; through the glass it is night, and inside it white doves wheel slowly between the dark trees while golden orbs drift upward and the small moon glows. She spreads her fingers against the glass, and the glass ripples outward from her palm like the surface of water. Her indigo cloak stirs as a cool breath of night air blows out of the window into the courtyard. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward the window and her hand.
[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, the camera cuts to <Picture 2>. <Subject 1> is inside the night forest now, walking to the right along the mossy path in profile, her indigo cloak swinging behind her and her vermilion tunic bright against the teal trees. White doves glide low beside her and pass her, leading the way, golden orbs bob between the trunks, and white flowers sway as she passes. Far back at the upper left, the round window she came through still glows with warm daylight among the trees, slowly growing smaller. The camera tracks with her at walking speed as she follows the doves deeper into the forest.
[Shot 3] At 00:10.000, the shot cuts to <Picture 3>. <Subject 1> stops at the edge of a still black pond, seen from behind in the right foreground. The moon's reflection shivers on the water, white doves wade and dip their heads, and golden orbs float on the surface. Across the pond, beside a fragment of sunlit plaster wall with a round window, stands <Subject 2>, dressed exactly like her. <Subject 2> slowly turns her head to look across the water at <Subject 1> and lifts one hand. <Subject 1> goes still, then slowly raises her own hand in answer. The camera holds a static shot as a dove lifts off the water between them.

overall_soundscape:
In [Shot 1], a soft warm breeze moves through the courtyard, and when the glass ripples a cool hush of crickets and distant wings spills out of the window. In [Shot 2], her footsteps press softly into moss, cloth rustles, doves' wings flutter past close by, and crickets chirp steadily under the trees. In [Shot 3], the crickets fall quiet, water laps gently as the doves wade, and a single set of wings beats as a dove lifts off the pond.

non_diegetic_music:
A solo kalimba plays a slow repeating figure at about 60 BPM; at 00:05.000 soft pizzicato strings and a low sustained cello join and grow slightly louder; at 00:10.000 the strings stop and the kalimba plays alone, slowing until it ends on one held note.
